research_philosophy: Mathematical, empirical, mechanism-first, falsifiable, reproducible. No discretionary technical analysis.
core_thesis: Price is an output/coordinate of market state, not the complete state itself. The same market action can have different consequences depending on surrounding state.

entries.title: Absorption vs Yielding: opposing near-touch liquidity response conditional on aggressive flow
entries.hypothesis: Conditional on aggressive trade flow, depletion of opposing displayed liquidity within 0-5 ticks is associated with greater subsequent flow-direction midpoint displacement than replenishment.

definitions.future_state: literal consecutive valid L2 events within same verified episode (H1 diagnostic, H3/H5/H10 primary)
definitions.temporal_ordering_rule: future shifts constructed BEFORE selecting starting flow events; never filter first then shift

discovery_results.frozen_conclusion: H3/H5/H10 survive; H1 diagnostic/weak. Frozen BEFORE replication.

replication_results.sample: 27,137 starting events; 502 unique verified episodes; BUY 14,145 / SELL 12,992; DEPLETION 22,775 / REPLENISHMENT 4,093 / NEUTRAL 269
replication_results.per_hour_sign: 5/5 untouched hours same sign at H3/H5/H10
replication_results.flow_depth_control: survives (weighted H3 +0.022130, H5 +0.030763, H10 +0.051320; positive cells 74-82%)
replication_results.sparsity: episode medians zero; zero rates 42.9-47.8%; positive rate among nonzero episodes 78.9-88.2% (NOT trading accuracy)
replication_results.concentration: top 20% of absolute episode effects account for 77.7-82.3% of total
replication_results.move_rate_vs_displacement: move-rate difference negative at H5/H10 while directional displacement increasingly positive (future research direction, not established)

entries.status: DISCOVERY COMPLETE / INDEPENDENT REPLICATION COMPLETE / FROZEN
entries.verdict: PASS (discovery + independent replication); H3/H5/H10 3/3 survive; strongest empirical mechanism in project
known_limitations: L2 aggregated price-level data, not L3 order identity
No causality, profitability, tradability, or execution feasibility established
Effect is sparse and state-dependent, not a universal market law
Replication covers 5 untouched hours, not months/years
Latency (~80-270 ms horizons) and transaction costs may overwhelm raw effect
entries.usage_policy: May be used for debugging, unit tests, reproducing recorded results, software regression tests. MUST NOT be used to optimize tick width, flow thresholds, horizons, state filters, entry/exit thresholds, or ML hyperparameters for claims of independent performance.

entries.title: Directional Boundary Re-Anchoring prospective replication
entries.hypothesis: BTC down + long stop boundary re-anchor downward -> future longward retail reallocation; BTC up + short stop boundary re-anchor upward -> future shortward retail reallocation.

definitions.down_dbr: BTC 20m return < 0 AND long cluster changed AND long migration < 0
definitions.up_dbr: BTC 20m return > 0 AND short cluster changed AND short migration > 0

primary_endpoints: 20-minute event minus anchored-control mean counter-directional position reallocation

discovery_results.notes: Downside effects persisted longer; upside weakened with horizon. Confounding: DBR events had larger BTC moves; linear absolute-return controls may not fully remove magnitude confounding. NOT declared causal or tradable.

replication_results.note: FXSSI subscription/data access ended ~Sep 11 2026; expected to resume ~Tuesday. Do not modify experiment while waiting.

entries.verdict: Discovery-stage candidate; frozen prospective specification active; awaiting new data
entries.usage_policy: Frozen. No post-hoc magnitude threshold optimization. No changing event definitions after prospective outcomes appear. No deleting unfavorable events.

entries.title: Retail reallocation/flow state vs BTC direction
entries.hypothesis: Same broad retail reallocation/flow state can occur during opposite BTC price directions; retail state is not a deterministic directional signal.
entries.verdict: Intensity and surrounding state matter; retail state not deterministic directional signal

entries.title: Chronology: BTC impulse -> retail ecology response
entries.hypothesis: BTC price impulse -> retail ecology response is stronger than retail ecology -> future BTC.
entries.discovery_results: Strong BTC up -> long retail mass down, short mass up; strong BTC down -> long mass up, short mass down (counter-directional retail reallocation).

entries.title: Falsification of broad symmetric response hypothesis
entries.hypothesis: Broad symmetric counter-directional response did NOT survive unchanged. UP moves: broad response near zero; DOWN moves: more consistent; largest shocks: mirror response both sides. Magnitude dependence nonlinear/nonmonotonic.
entries.refined_candidate: A1: Large BTC displacement -> counter-directional sampled retail reallocation, downside broader, upside requires larger shocks.
entries.status: DISCOVERY COMPLETE (refined candidate A1 remains discovery-stage)

entries.title: Price is not state (descriptive)
entries.hypothesis: Same/similar-price observations can possess different ecological states; future path divergence larger when ecology differs.
entries.verdict: PASS - price is not state descriptively. Does NOT establish directional prediction.

entries.title: Ecological transition atlas
entries.hypothesis: Binary axes R (reallocation), A (directional activity), P (participation), O (open-interest expansion/contraction).
entries.discovery_results: ~390 complete observations; 10/16 theoretical states observed; top 4 states ~86.7% of observations; recurring transition patterns and three-step episodes.
entries.verdict: Recurring ecological organization detected. NOT a profitable trading rule or future-direction classifier.

entries.title: Stop ecology / DBR discovery
entries.hypothesis: Stop clusters frequently anchored (~83.6%; 64 long + 64 short reanchors). Stock/flow: Stock(t+1) = Stock(t) + Flow(t) + Reset(t). EXP-25 produced DBR candidate; EXP-26 compared DBR events with anchored controls.
entries.status: DISCOVERY COMPLETE (led to frozen DBR prospective specification)

pandas read_csv default C parser drops the last ULP of long float reprs (e.g. 0.10000000000582077 -> 0.1000000000058207). Tests comparing floats bit-for-bit must use float_precision='round_trip'.

Frozen d07_liquidity_event_tape CSVs store UTC columns as strings with MIXED fractional-second formats (some rows '...00+00:00', others '...00.163000+00:00'; hours 12/18/15/21 + discovery affected, hour 04 uniform 6-digit). Parsing requires pd.to_datetime(..., utc=True, format='mixed'). The refactored module emits datetime64[ns, UTC]; tests cast both sides to datetime64[us, UTC] before comparison. Input-parser fix only - frozen CSVs untouched, equality checks unchanged.

Frozen d09_joint_flow_liquidity_tape CSVs embed default-parser last-ULP artifacts (e.g. spread_t1 0.1000000000058207 vs the d07 source 0.10000000000582077) because the canonical D09 read the D07 book CSV with pandas' DEFAULT parser. The refactored src/liquidity/joint_flow.py must read the book CSV with the default parser to reproduce frozen output bit-for-bit; tests read frozen with round_trip (O7). The same artifact propagates into frozen d09b joint outputs (spread_t0 0.0999999999912688).

On this machine (4 CPUs, ~4.1 GB RAM) the 3-worker multiprocessing pool thrashes memory: the D07 harness took ~21 min wall for 6 hours while a single serial hour takes ~77 s. Heavy per-hour replays are run serially, one hour per process, with per-hour checkpoints (tests/logs/checkpoints/<suite>/<hour>.pkl); the pool remains for light CSV-only suites (D09).

Downstream analysis consumes WRITTEN files, not in-memory frames: canonical exp01d/exp01e read the written exp01c_canonical_rows.csv with the DEFAULT parser, so the default-parser last-ULP artifacts (O9) propagate through the written file. The refactored exp01d/exp01e tests must feed them the CSV-read frame (read_input('exp01c_canonical_rows.csv')) rather than the in-memory analysis frame; exp01c itself (frame + summary) is validated against the in-memory frame. Replication analysis reads the hour joint CSVs directly, so no written-file hop is involved.

main_risks: Transaction costs (raw effect sizes are fractions of a basis point)
Execution observability (can state be detected early enough to act)
Fill uncertainty (L2 has no queue position)
Long-run stability (replication covers hours, not months/years)
Multiple testing (new hypotheses must be frozen before testing)
Overfitting (May data must not become a threshold-optimization playground)
